fullContentHtml:
UPPSC Result 2024 PDF Out: The Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission announced the UPPCS Final Result 2024 on 29th March 2026 @uppsc.up.nic.in. This is the final result pdf for the Uttar Pradesh Combined State/Upper Subordinate Exam (UPPSC PCS) 2024 cycle. The result has been announced after the completion of the Prelims, Mains, and Interview stages. Candidates who had appeared for the exam can check the UPPSC 2024 Result PDF release date, download link, and other details here.

यूपीपीसीएस परिणाम 2024 घोषित: उत्तर प्रदेश लोक सेवा आयोग (यूपीएससी) ने यूपीपीसीएस का अंतिम परिणाम 2024 दिनांक 29 मार्च 2026 को घोषित किया। यह उत्तर प्रदेश संयुक्त राज्य/उच्च अधीनस्थ परीक्षा (यूपीएससी पीसीएस) 2024 सत्र का अंतिम परिणाम है। प्रारंभिक, मुख्य और साक्षात्कार चरणों के संपन्न होने के बाद परिणाम घोषित किया गया है। परीक्षा में शामिल हुए उम्मीदवार यूपीपीएससी परिणाम जारी होने की तिथि, डाउनलोड लिंक और अन्य विवरण यहां देख सकते हैं।

UPPSC Final Result 2024 Out

The UPPSC Final Result 2024 PDF has been announced @uppsc.up.nic.in, after the completion of the interview stage from 16th February 2026 to 20th March 2026. The result was prepared based on the performance of the candidates in the Mains Exam and Interview. According to the result, a total of 932 candidates have been shortlisted for a total of 947 vacancies under the Uttar Pradesh State and Upper Subordinate Services.

उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य एवं उच्च अधीनस्थ सेवा (UPPCS) के 2024 सत्र का अंतिम परिणाम @uppsc.up.nic.in पर घोषित कर दिया गया है। साक्षात्कार प्रक्रिया 16 फरवरी 2026 से 20 मार्च 2026 तक संपन्न हुई थी। परिणाम मुख्य परीक्षा और साक्षात्कार में उम्मीदवारों के प्रदर्शन के आधार पर तैयार किया गया है। परिणाम के अनुसार, उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य एवं उच्च अधीनस्थ सेवाओं के अंतर्गत कुल रिक्त पदों के लिए उम्मीदवारों का चयन किया गया है।

UPPSC Final Result 2024: Key Highlights
Exam Conducting Body Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC)
Official Website uppsc.up.nic.in
Exam Name Uttar Pradesh Combined State/Upper Subordinate Exam (UPPSC PCS)
Exam Cycle 2024
Exam Stages Prelims, Mains, Interview
Interview Dates 16th February 2026 to 20th March 2026
Final Result Date 29 March 2026
UPPSC Final Result 2024 Release Date 2026

UPPCS Final Result 2024 PDF Download Link

The UPPSC Final Result 2024 is now available on the commission’s website in the form of a PDF containing the roll number-wise list of candidates shortlisted for the vacancies under UPPCS. Candidates can view and download their results from the official website or by using the direct link given below.

Download UPPCS Final Result PDF (2024)

How to Download UPPSC Final Result 2024 PDF?

The final UPPCS Result 2024 PDF is available for download on the commission’s official website. To download the UPPSC result PDF, follow the steps mentioned below:

Step 1: Go to the UPPSC official website @uppsc.up.nic.in.

Step 2: Proceed to the Results section under the ‘Important Segments’.

Step 3: Click on the UPPCS Final Result download link.

Step 4: The UPPSC Result PDF will appear on your screen. Find your roll number/ name in the result.

Step 5: Download and save the result for reference.

Details Mentioned on the UPPCS Final Result 2024

The UPPSC PCS Final Result PDF contains the roll number-wise list of candidates shortlisted for final appointment. It also contains other important details. Candidates must make sure to check these details carefully to avoid any discrepancies later. The information mentioned on the final UPPCS Result includes:

  • Exam Cycle
  • Exam Dates
  • Number of shortlisted candidates
  • Names and roll numbers of the shortlisted candidates
  • The category of the candidate shortlisted
  • Instructions for the candidates.

What’s Next After Announcement of the UPPCS Result 2026?

Now that the UPPSC Final Result for the PCS 2024 Exam has been announced, the shortlisted candidates will be issued their appointment letters in due course of time. After getting the appointment letters, candidates will have to complete the required formalities and documentation as instructed, and report to the joining office as and when specified. Candidates must regularly check the commission’s website and their registered email/ phone number for more updates and details about the same.

We hope these details about the UPPCS Final Result 2026 were informative. To prepare for the upcoming state and central government exams, download the Testbook App. It has mock tests, online classes, previous year papers, quizzes, and other useful resources.

FAQs on UPPCS PCS Final Result 2026

Ques: When was the UPPCS Final Result 2026 announced?

Ans: The UPPSC PCS Final Result (2024 cycle) was announced on 29th March 2026.

Ques: On what basis is the UPPSC PCS Merit List prepared?

Ans: The UPPSC merit list is prepared based on the marks scored by the candidates in the Mains Exam and Interview.

Ques: What are the details given in the UPPCS Result 2026?

Ans: The UPPSC PCS Final Result contains the names, roll numbers, and categories of the shortlisted candidates. Other than that, the number of shortlisted candidates, exam date, instructions for further selection, etc., are also mentioned on the result.

Ques: Where can I find the UPPCS Final Result PDF 2026?

Ans: The UPPSC PCS Result PDF is available on the commission’s official website @uppsc.up.nic.in.

Ques: Do I need to log in to view the UPPSC PCS Final Result?

Ans: No, as the result is available in the form of a PDF, you can easily download it without the need to login.
